6325.title: Provider fork uses the wrong transcript environment
6325.rootCauseOneLine: The bridge runs SDK fork lookup in its own environment before applying project-specific transcript settings to the resumed session.
6325.proposedFix: Use the session-specific transcript environment for isolated fork lookup, and preserve the original fork descriptor during a failed-start retry.
6325.caveats: Provider-boundary reproduction with real SDK fork and synthetic transcripts, repeated in a clean checkout; no live UI/CLI or subsequent empty-session claim verified. Retry is traced statically and validated at the contract boundary only. Five existing bridge tests fail in the UID-0 runner, blocking the safe-fix green-suite gate.
